findings.severity: BLOCKING — functional regression vs round 1, introduced by D9+D10 together
findings.title: An End-User-only contact is brand-gate-DENIED, and D10 then deletes the Q23 answer
findings.customer_boundary: exec 12045520, entitlement ['End User'], message 'office promo for SRTBF11710'. Verbatim reply: "You don't have access to office promotions — here's what you do have:\n\nWould you like me to escalate to marketing_promotion_sorento team?" — the sentence promises a list and is followed by nothing. 0 answers, 0 attachments, 0 file egress. Round 1 (exec 12041445) answered with the notice + 6 files.
findings.mechanism: tier-gate.js: parseLevel('End User') returns {brand:null,...}, so mapEntitlement(['End User']).brands === []. The LLM emitted access_levels ['Sorento Office'] for a message that said only 'office'; D9 unions that into query_brands ['sorento']. recompose() computes brandGateEmpty = qb.length>0 && !qb.some(b => entMap.brands.includes(b)), which is UNCONDITIONALLY TRUE for any brandless entitlement. brand_gate_empty true then (a) skips the Q23 widen branch, which is guarded on !brand_gate_empty, and (b) triggers D10's top-of-node guard in promo-picker, which wipes answers and attachments before any other exit path.
findings.why_it_matters: It contradicts plan §3 verbatim ('"End User" -> {brand: null (all entitled brands)}') and plan journey rows 4 and 6, and it is the exact bound the round-2 brief asked me to check ('D10 must not eat the tier-level Q23 answer'). recompose()'s own loop even has a comment saying end_user is brandless and should be included whenever its tier is chosen — but that inclusion happens AFTER brandGateEmpty has already been decided and exported.
findings.bounded_by: exec 12046052 — the SAME query on entitlement ['Sorento Dealer','End User'] passes (notice + answer + 6 files, brand_gate_empty false). So the defect is specifically the brandless End-User-only contact.
findings.suggested_shape_of_fix: brandGateEmpty must not be true when the contact's chosen tier(s) include a brandless level, or more generally when entMap.brands is empty (no brand axis to gate on). Not my call to make — flagged for the planner/coder.

findings.severity: design risk, no wrong denial observed
findings.title: The brand gate now keys on a brand the LLM inferred, not one the customer said
findings.evidence: 'promo for SRTBF11710 dealer' — no brand word anywhere — makes the LLM emit access_levels ['Sorento Dealer'] (execs 12044625, 12047071), and D9 promotes that to query_brands ['sorento'], which is a security-gate input. Deterministic: 4/4 identical runs (12045877/12045892/12045908/12045921) produced the same denial for a Cabana-Dealer contact. Round 1 discarded the brand half and recomposed all three brands here.
findings.counter_evidence_I_looked_for: I tried to make it produce a WRONG denial — a Cabana product, no brand word, Cabana-entitled contact (execs 12045972/12045990/12046006). It did not: the LLM emitted the cabana-inclusive set and the gate stayed open, 2 files served. So in practice the inference tracks the product-code prefix. I am reporting the coupling, not claiming a live leak.
findings.why_it_still_matters: An access boundary whose input is an LLM field the customer never uttered will drift with the model. It is also the proximate trigger of F1.

findings.severity: observation — D9 is narrower than 'word order no longer matters'
findings.title: D9 fixes the ACCESS/routing half of the word-order dependency, not the SEARCH half
findings.evidence: Same contact, same product, full entitlement, uac: 'cabana promo for CBS212-WH dealer' (12045322) -> 2 Cabana files. 'cabana dealer promo for CBS212-WH' (12045342) -> 'No promotion for CBS212-WH. Try: CBS202-WH, CBS204-WH…'. Both now produce query_brands ['cabana'] and route to marketing_promotion_cabana (that is the D9 fix, and it works), but only the first phrasing yields a hint:'brand' ENTITY, and the entity is what scopes the SEARCH. Per D6 that is by design — worth saying out loud because 'the gate fires regardless of word order' can be misread as 'the answer is the same regardless of word order'. It is not.

findings.severity: functional gap, contradicts TA.md TA-8 and plan journey row 5
findings.title: A follow-up on a tier-scoped answer silently re-widens to the full entitlement
findings.evidence: exec 12044849. After TA-2's dealer-scoped answer (2 DEALER pdfs), 'the august one' no longer re-asks the tier (D11 works: _pending_pick true, tier_ask false) but it also does not resolve against the ANSWER: reference_positions [], no date narrowing, tier-gate recomposes all 7 entitlement names, and the customer receives 6 files including the OFFICE and END USER pdfs plus both non-August promotions. reasons: F1 is a functional REGRESSION against round 1 on a case TA.md specifies and the plan's own journey rows 4 and 6 depend on: an End-User-only contact asking for an unheld tier gets a notice promising a list and then nothing. Promoting this trades the round-1 leak for a round-1 answer that has stopped being served.
F1 also contradicts plan §3's stated mapper semantics ('End User -> all entitled brands'), so it is a plan-conformance defect, not a debatable edge case.
F4 leaves TA-8 / plan journey row 5 only half satisfied.

The D9-fallback bound (an older/live parser with no query_brands) is UNTESTED end-to-end because the fork has no injection point for it; the promote order in the node-diff is 'parser first, then spine', which is exactly the window in which a spine running against a not-yet-promoted parser matters.
what_is_genuinely_fixed_and_should_survi: D10 — the brand-gate leak is closed at the customer boundary, proven against a deliberately NON-EMPTY pinned CRM payload, so the denial is n8n's own and round 1's BLOCKER-2 (the unverified 'CRM returns nothing for access_levels: []' assumption) no longer sits on the access boundary.
D9 — the compound-stated brand is recovered regardless of word order AND the escalation offer now names the cabana team (round 1 silently downgraded it to sorento).

D11 — a pending non-tier pick no longer has the ask fired on top of it (TA-14a), a continuation no longer re-asks (TA-8's blocker), the ask still re-fires on an entity-less non-pick (D11-EXCL), and D4 is not repealed (TA-7).
The tier filter is now proven load-bearing against the real CRM rather than under pinning: same product, 2 / 4 / 6 files for dealer / office+dealer / all.
before_the_next_round: Fix F1 and add a case with an End-User-only entitlement AND a tier word in the message — TA-6 does not cover it because that phrasing makes the LLM emit no access_levels at all.
Decide F2: whether query_brands may be sourced from an LLM-inferred compound level at all, or must be corroborated by the brand appearing in the customer's text / as an entity.
Give the harness a parser-output injection point so the D9 legacy-parser bound can be driven, and a resolver-working contact that is not a live customer.
